correctness.rationale: PASS: In the exact publisher Fokker–Planck equation, the allowed zero amplitudes σ_S=σ_I=0 reduce the PDE to ∂_t f+div(Ff)=0. For stated smooth F and Ω=(0,2)² the vector field points inward/tangentially on every square side; f0=25·1_(1/5,2/5)² is normalized L² probability. The smooth flow has positive finite Jacobian and pushes the initial discontinuity to a nonzero jump across smooth interior curves at every finite t; distributional spatial gradient has singular surface measure and f(t)∉H¹. Thus it cannot be in L²(0,T;H¹). Direct rational boundary/mass calculations were independently reproduced. Positivity, mass and uniqueness in distributional transport remain true; only the claimed general H¹ existence fails.
